title: E-Moto Mania - Free browser game! Race against the clock for medals! 3000+ tarcks, or build your own!
author: 1up8192
selftext:
Try out my browser game, I used AI to help development, it is simple and tons of fun!

Ported and modernized from old mobile game from my highschool years called Gravity Defied: Trial Racing and added features inspired by Trackmania

Features:

* Playable in browser on desktop and touch screens, mobile, tablet (please someone test it on smart TV and fridge :D)
* Minimalist 4 button game-play
* Completely deterministic physics
* Super light graphics, performant engine on any platform
* Low input latency, millisecond time resolution

You can:

* Play 30 original Gravity Defied tracks or 3000+ custom tracks
* Beat all medal times, and "Author time" set by me if you are a pro!
* Rewatch or race against your own PR ghost to improve
* Create you own tracks

I am constantly developing it, coming soon:

* Leaderboards
* Profiles
* Track, replay sharing
* Multiplayer servers

I would love some to hear some feedback if you like it or not, or found some bugs!
